purpose: Every autonomous proposition must carry a scientific birth certificate answering eight audit questions. If any required answer cannot be derived from recorded evidence, the proposition does NOT qualify as autonomous.

questions.question: What exactly was observed?
questions.pass_criterion: References concrete empirical statistics, distributions, trajectories, or tool-result payloads — not merely an OBS/GAP label.
fail_examples: Because OBS_03 exists in the interpreter output

questions.question: Why was that observation surprising, unresolved, asymmetric, conflicting, or unexplained?
questions.pass_criterion: States a quantitative or structural contrast against a declared baseline, prior expectation, or competing sub-population — with evidence pointers.
fail_examples: This gap type is worth exploring

questions.question: What scientific question arose from it?
questions.pass_criterion: Question is a direct inference from Q1+Q2, not a lookup from template catalog.
fail_examples: Does dispersion predict returns? (because template T8 exists)

questions.question: What proposition is being tested?
questions.pass_criterion: Falsifiable claim with explicit population, relation, outcome, and horizon when relevant.
fail_examples: Reframe of existing template with synonym population label only

questions.question: What evidence would support it?
questions.pass_criterion: Directional or threshold-based expectation that an experiment could measure.
fail_examples: If true, returns will be different

questions.question: What evidence would weaken or falsify it?
questions.pass_criterion: At least one concrete disconfirming pattern, null outcome, or stronger competing explanation.
fail_examples: Only states 'null hypothesis is no effect' without operational test

questions.question: Why is this proposition not merely a reformulation of an existing template/question?
questions.pass_criterion: template_independence_audit.classification in {TEMPLATE_ADJACENT, SCIENTIFICALLY_NOVEL} OR TEMPLATE_REFRAME with documented new scientific axis from observation.
fail_examples: Same GAP family, same population/outcome, only horizon changed without new observational motivation

questions.question: What executable experiment could test it?
questions.pass_criterion: Maps to legal ExperimentSpec grammar with resolvable tool, population, outcome, horizon.
fail_examples: Conceptual proposition with no legal execution path
Requires unavailable columns or illegal grammar

qualification_rule.autonomous_qualified: ALL eight questions pass AND template_independence_audit.classification NOT IN {TEMPLATE_INSTANCE, INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE}
qualification_rule.non_autonomous_but_executable: May still execute as human-seeded/template-derived research — must be labeled TEMPLATE_INSTANCE or TEMPLATE_REFRAME
qualification_rule.reject: Any required field missing OR BC_Q1/Q2 fail OR classification INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE
